notes: Independent exact recomputation on the reported C4 gives components G[S] = {0},{2} and G[T] = {1},{3}, so the solution constructs the four singleton pieces {0-1}, {0-3}, {1-2}, and {2-3}. Exhaustively enumerating all seven proper bipartitions up to complementation shows that none of these singleton sets equals delta(X). Independently, deleting any one of them leaves C4 connected: the component count remains 1. Also, the asserted identity Cij = delta(Si) fails explicitly because delta({0}) = {0-1,0-3}, not {0-1}. Thus every constructed Cij fails even to be a cut-set, let alone a minimal cut. The refuted statement is a substantive central claim of Step 3, not a typo the author plainly did not mean. The general theorem may still be true, but this proposed decomposition does not prove it.
